native_retrieval.snippet: ## The context you need, when you need it. When news breaks, you need to understand what actually matters — and what to do about it. Why even many wealthy people in China’s richest city can’t reliably get food — and what it says about the country’s political system. A transit officer controls access to a tunnel in the direction of Shanghai’s Pudong district as a government-imposed lockdown began March 28 to curb the spread of Covid-19. They were given little time to prepare provisions for what they were told would be a few days trapped at home to combat the spread of Covid-19. On top of all of that, it’s not exactly clear how much Covid-19 spread and death the most extreme measures have actually prevented.
